crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and…
‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to…
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
“Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to…
Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman…
Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

translations.web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
translations.bsb: Listen to your father who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
translations.asv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, And despise not thy mother when she is old.
